D: A young inventor's machine makes food rain from the sky over his small island town.
P: Serve the mains when the first cheeseburgers start falling.
S: Mashed sardines with lemon and parsley on sourdough toast, sliced radish

Tinned sardines mashed with butter, lemon and parsley, spread on sourdough toast, finished with sliced radish and black pepper. Mash 2 drained tins of sardines with 30g soft butter, lemon juice and chopped parsley. Spread on 8 slices toasted sourdough and top with thinly sliced radish and black pepper.
Smashed beef patties with American cheese, pickles and onion on slider buns
Beef sliders smashed thin on a hot griddle, American cheese melted on, pickles, onion and burger sauce on soft slider buns, stacked high on a platter.

Wobbly cubes of orange, raspberry and lime jelly made with real juice, stacked into a castle on a platter with whipped cream turrets. For each colour, soften 4 tsp gelatine in 3 tbsp cold water, then dissolve in 300ml warm juice with 2 tbsp sugar: orange juice, raspberry juice and lime cordial diluted with water. Pour each into its own lined loaf tin and chill 4 hours until firm. Cut into 3cm cubes and stack into a castle on a platter. Pipe whipped cream from 200ml cream on top.
M: Big beef and pork meatballs simmered in tomato sauce over spaghetti
Big beef and pork meatballs with soaked bread, parmesan and parsley, browned, simmered 45 minutes in tomato sauce with basil, over a twisting pile of spaghetti.
Steak storm garlic butter rump and fries

Rump steaks seared in a smoking pan, rested and sliced, topped with melting garlic and parsley butter, with shoestring fries salted straight from the oven. Mash 80g soft butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves, chopped parsley and salt, roll into a log and chill. Bake 800g shoestring fries at 220C for 20 minutes. Season 4 rump steaks of 200g and sear in a smoking pan, flipping every minute, for 6 to 8 minutes. Rest 5 minutes, slice and top with discs of garlic butter. Salt the fries and serve.
W: Vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream with sprinkles, wafers and hot fudge
Vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream scooped into a big snowy mountain, with sprinkles, wafer biscuits and hot fudge.
K: Raspberry, orange and lime syrups layered under lemonade
Layers of raspberry, orange and lime syrups in a glass, topped with lemonade so the colours run together.

ingredients.item: tins brown lentils (400 g each), drained

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the oil until dry and browned, then cool.
Soak the bread in a little water and squeeze it out. Mash the lentils roughly and mix with the bread, mushrooms, egg, half the cheese and the chopped parsley.
Roll into big balls and brown all over in the remaining oil.
Simmer gently in the tomatoes with basil, turning the meatballs carefully once.
Cook the spaghetti.
Pile over the pasta and top with the rest of the cheese.
Melt the chocolate gently with the cream for hot fudge.
Scoop the ice creams into a big mountain on a platter.
Cover with sprinkles, stick in wafers and pour over the hot fudge.

dishes.make_ahead: Blitz and strain the raspberry layer and mix the orange and lime layers up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; layer in the glasses and top with lemonade just before serving

steps.text: Blitz the raspberries with a third of the sugar and strain.
Mix the orange juice with a third of the sugar.
Mix the lime juice with the rest of the sugar until dissolved.
Spoon a layer of each into four tall glasses and top slowly with lemonade so the colours run together.

s.note: Mashed sardines with lemon and parsley on sourdough toast, sliced radish
s.how: Mash 2 drained tins of sardines with 30g soft butter, lemon juice and chopped parsley. Spread on 8 slices toasted sourdough and top with thinly sliced radish and black pepper.

s.note: Smashed beef patties with American cheese, pickles and onion on slider buns
s.how: Smash 12 small patties from 500g beef mince on a hot griddle and melt American cheese on top. Put into slider buns with pickles, onion and burger sauce. Stack them high on a platter.

m.note: Big beef and pork meatballs simmered in tomato sauce over spaghetti
m.how: Mix 400g beef mince and 300g pork mince with 2 slices soaked bread, 40g parmesan and parsley. Roll into 8 big balls and brown. Simmer 45 minutes in 2 tins tomatoes with basil. Pile over 500g spaghetti.

w.note: Vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream with sprinkles, wafers and hot fudge
w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream. Scoop vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream into a big mountain on a platter. Cover with sprinkles, stick in wafer biscuits and pour over the hot fudge.

d.note: Raspberry, orange and lime syrups layered under lemonade
d.how: Make three syrups: blitzed raspberries with sugar, orange juice with sugar, and lime juice with sugar. Spoon a layer of each into four tall glasses and top slowly with lemonade so the colours run together.
